description: Finger C-423 restored at Tandil in December 2017 to represent Dagger C-434 of the 1982 war, trucked to Pilar 3 March 2018 and unveiled 2 April 2018 in front of the replica Stella Maris chapel; photographed September 2018 and reported April 2022.

description: C-130H c/n 382-4576, written off landing at Tandil 16 May 1996; fuselage moved to the cenotaph 29 December 2017 to be rebuilt as a mini-cinema representing TC-63 shot down 1 June 1982; restoration still in progress in 2022.
museum_name: Cenotafio de Malvinas Pilar Aircraft Memorials

description: Tail boom and tail rotor only of UH-1H-BF c/n 13842 (ex 74-22518, 1982 war veteran 'María Auxiliadora'), erected vertically in 2014 as the Monumento a la Aviación de Ejército; reported April 2022.
